Veterans Benefits: Texas has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Disabled veterans receive a rating-scaled residence-homestead exemption, and a 100% service-connected or individually unemployable veteran receives a total homestead property-tax exemption, with surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: Tyler is the regional healthcare and cultural hub of East Texas, known as the Rose Capital of America and nestled in the Piney Woods. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, strong regional hospital networks (UT Health and CHRISTUS), Texas's no-income-tax advantage on military retirement pay, and outdoor recreation at Tyler State Park and nearby lakes. Tradeoffs include hot, humid summers, a moderate crime rate, and no local Costco warehouse.
